settings.transparent_header_background_info: Shown on the home page when the header is transparent. Use fully transparent or a light tint so text stays readable over the hero.
settings.minimized_nav_alignment_info: Controls where the navigation links sit in the compact sticky header on desktop
settings.show_desktop_search_bar: Show search bar on homepage header

settings.desktop_search_style_info: Custom: live autocomplete dropdown with recent searches and product suggestions. Default: opens the theme's full predictive-search modal.
settings.homepage_search_typing_enabled_info: Animates the search hint one character at a time on the home page (custom dropdown search only). Uses the field below, or the main placeholder if that is blank.
settings.homepage_search_typing_text_info: Shown as the animated hint. Leave blank to use “Search bar placeholder text” above.
settings.homepage_search_typing_color_info: Optional color for the animated placeholder text. Leave unset to use the main search text color.

settings.search_bar_border_color_info: Subtle border in the default (unfocused) state
settings.search_bar_focus_color_info: Border and glow color when the search bar is active
settings.mobile_vision_text_size_info: Applies to Paragraph, Custom, and Default blocks in the vision column except the first block (that one uses Vision heading (eyebrow)). Heading presets H1âH4 use block/theme sizing. Icon row uses Icon row settings.
settings.leaf_section_background_info: Overrides the color scheme background for this section. Foreground, links, and buttons still follow the color scheme above.
settings.vision_padding_inline_mobile_info: On screens under 750px, replaces left/right padding from text blocks (e.g. Heading) inside column vision stacks. Does not affect the horizontal icon row.
settings.vision_heading_text_size_info: Eyebrow / kicker in the vision column: H5 and H6 blocks, or the first Paragraph/Custom/Default block when it is the first block in that column. Main vision copy should be the next block (e.g. Heading or Paragraph). Does not affect icon row.
settings.vision_heading_text_size_mobile_info: Same as desktop, on screens under 750px.
settings.icon_row_cell_layout_mobile_info: Under 750px, these settings control each icon group in the horizontal row and override the block's mobile width.
settings.leaf_mobile_max_width_info: Under 750px, leaf size is the smaller of these two caps (viewport % and pixels). Raise both for a larger corner graphic.
settings.category_explore_image_alt_info: Describe the main image for screen readers. Falls back to the card title if empty.
settings.category_explore_image_hover_info: Shown on hover (desktop) when a main image is set. Uses a fade transition.
settings.category_explore_blocks_info: Add theme blocks (such as headings) before category cards in the block list. Consecutive category cards are placed in the asymmetric grid; theme blocks render in editor order outside the grid.
settings.category_explore_card_max_width_info: Caps how wide the card is inside its grid cell (centered). Set to 0 for full cell width.
settings.category_explore_card_min_height_info: 0 uses the default height for this grid slot. Set a value to override.
settings.category_explore_icon_color_info: Defaults to the label color if not set.
settings.category_explore_overlay_color_info: Leave blank to use the default dark gradient.
settings.category_explore_section_height_info: 0 = automatic height based on card content.
settings.category_explore_section_height_desktop_: Sets the exact grid height on desktop â cards auto-fill the rows proportionally. 0 = automatic.
settings.category_explore_section_height_mobile_i: Sets a minimum height on mobile. 0 = automatic.
settings.category_explore_label_row_position_info: Places the title and arrow row vertically on the card. The title and arrow stay on one line and align with each other.
settings.category_explore_card_radius_info: Used on the desktop grid (990px and up).
settings.category_explore_card_radius_mobile_info: Used on the mobile and tablet grid (under 990px).
settings.category_explore_grid_gap_info: Space between cards on the desktop grid. Mobile and tablet use the settings below.
settings.category_explore_grid_gap_mobile_info: Applies to the two-column layout on screens under 990px.
settings.category_explore_mobile_row_min_info: Minimum height for the two side-by-side cards in this row. The row can still grow with viewport width and free space.
settings.category_explore_mobile_row_wide_info: Minimum height for the full-width card at the bottom. The row can still grow with viewport width and free space.
settings.enable_custom_product_page_frame: Enable custom max width and horizontal insets
settings.custom_footer_trust_home_only_info: When enabled, this banner is not shown on collection, product, and other pages—only on the home page footer.
settings.custom_footer_trust_region_heading_info: Announced as the section title for assistive technology. Not required to be visible.
